Synopsis:
Ground-level Reuters report from Druzhkivka, a town on Ukraine's eastern "fortress belt," ~15km from Russian front lines. Documents civilian devastation, widespread urban destruction, and drone warfare intensity. Russian forces continue incremental advances toward the Donbas region despite over four years of full-scale war, with Ukrainian defenses holding but under sustained pressure.
